correctness.rationale: Definitions and two-sided coefficient hypotheses are explicit. Finite triangular matrices have inverse I−L of norm <=2 and rank-(j−1) approximations with error <=ceil(N/j), proving all requisite singular estimates. Dyadic row decomposition plus Schatten p-power triangle yields sufficiency for alpha*p>1 (p<1), and trace-class at p=1. All N singular values of disjoint diagonal compressions are >=c*2^(-alpha-1)*N^(-alpha), contradicting ideal-tail continuity for alpha*p<=1. Direct rational shift-matrix computation proves the Cesaro corollary. Actual package VERIFY.py gave 132051 exact finite checks, not substituted for proof.
